name: ZX_BUCKETS_F
description: This table stores detail information about tax to date amount and taxable to date amount buckets associated with a first party. In addition, it could be related to third party such as supplier or customer.

columns.name: TAX_BUCKET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the tax bucket.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code associated with the tax bucket.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user.

columns.name: ACCUMULATED_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cumulative tax amount to date for the period.

columns.name: ACCUMULATED_TAXABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cumulative taxable amount to date for the period.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime associated with the tax bucket.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code associated with the tax bucket.

columns.name: CALENDAR_NAME
columns.description: Name of tax calendar defined in ZX_CALENDARS. Used when the schedule basis is set to "period".

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Calendar period associated with the tax bucket.

columns.name: BUCKET_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the bucket is for procure to pay or order to cash transactions.

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_TAX_PROF_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for third party. Foreign key to the party tax profile table.

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_SITE_TAX_PROF_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for third party site. Foreign key to the party tax profile table.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier associated with the bucket.

columns.name: FIRST_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the first party organization.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code associated with the withholding tax bucket.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Stores TAN number when buckets are being maintained by TAN.

columns.name: ACCUMULATED_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maintains the accumulated line amounts of the transactions on which taxable amount is different from line amount.

columns.name: DOC_ACCUMULATED_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maintain the accumulated tax amounts of the transactions on which document level threshold has applied successfully. This is needed for cancellation flows to retain the total document threshold amount.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID
columns.description: Tax rate identifier used when the bucket was last updated.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_SCHED_ID
columns.description: Tax rate schedule identifier used when the bucket was last updated.

columns.name: RATE_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Tax rate percentage used when the bucket was last updated.

columns.name: RECALC_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether recalculation is required to be done.
